column1: # claims.tsv — localbench claim registry (working copy; reference copy: templates/claims.tsv).
# Anti-ceremony (CHECKLIST.md A12): consumer: the pre-commit hook + CI (B6);
#   gate: claim discipline — every enforced README claim resolves to a proof;
#   defect class: README drift, undecorated claims; delete when: never while
#   public claims exist (the registry is load-bearing, not ceremony).
# Columns: label | readme_pattern | capability_key | expected_substr | proof_path | enforce | notes
# readme_pattern must match README prose EXACTLY. Set enforce=yes only when proof_path holds a banked,
# same-generation receipt (packet §6) — a spike receipt is non-proof (packet §8).
# Status vocabulary in notes: planned / documented / implemented_uncertified / validated / certified / blocked / retired.

column2: The lean flags cut omp's default-profile prompt from 73,779 to 11,433 tokens.
column7: validated: omp 18.2.11 (sha ce797fb3ed92e768) + child overlay 62eed267e219ddde, ollama qwen3.6 tokenizer, recorded 2026-09-23; full = 73,779 in fixtures/omp/full.meta.json. Token counts are deterministic for a pinned omp + tokenizer (replay reproduced them within 2% on ollama). Earlier 11,650 / 74,289 came from the ~/.local/bin/omp build and memory-on prompts.

column2: On this Mac, Qwen3.6-35B-A3B prefills 6.4–6.6× faster than the qwen3.8 27B dense incumbent at 1k–8k tokens.
column7: validated: same-invocation A,B,A (ollama 0.32.15), no leg contended, preflight idle; micro.prefill_1k 6.407x and prefill_8k 6.572x with A/A bands 0.05; 32k is 5.746x with a 0.22 band, so the >=5x there is not claimed. Replay rows of this receipt are VOID (omp upgraded under the fixtures) by design.

column2: With the lean flags and memory off, omp on Qwen3.6-35B-A3B served by mlx-serve answered a tool-using task in 6.1 s on a cold first turn.
column7: validated: A/A pair, both legs every MUST PASS, uncontended, idle preflight; e2e.tool_read.first_wall_s 6.0838 / 5.9463 s, first call cached_tokens 0 (cold verified). Memory off = fixtures/omp/child-config.yml; the user's default profile with mnemopi memory on is NOT covered by this claim.

documented: mlx-serve golden legs pass every MUST, but cold first-turn wrong answers were seen on both MoE backends (ledger 2026-09-23); relcold/relfresh measure the rate. Not claimed until that rate is known.

documented: memory-off A/B (omp 18.2.11) B/A: decode 1.078x (band 0.05), e2e.ok.first_wall 0.807, e2e.tool_read.first_wall 0.874, replay.full.turn2 2.12x slower on mlx-serve; legs B and A2 had a cold e2e.ok MUST FAIL, so the release gate does not admit it.
